_comment: 最终航行「还剩下什么」+ 四个结局 + 人物短尾声（剧情姐合订稿 in1030/yun1.txt 第 153–240 行）。入口 start_final。通讯器：休息空隙妮芙·河岸来消息（final_msg_nifu_1/2）；结局一 phone_draft「我找到大象了。」（发送设 sent_found）；结局一~三和母星尾声 phone_open friend。燃料界面（todo_mechanic final_flight）选中一件纪念品时播 look_<id>，确认转化后播 burn_<id>（设 burned_<id>）。结局由两次 pick 决定（final_action：下降 / 漂行=结局四；final_nav：旧货场=一、东侧低鸣=二、居民区=三），设 final_ending_1..4；结局里的动作和尾声按 burned_* / final_seed_planted / 森林 returned_all、returned_any、saw_rock 分支。if / goto 是跳转（不返回）。markers 坐标都是占位 0。带 added 的是补写。

objectives.en: Go home
Visit Niff in the river city
Visit Milo at the treehouse
Back to the ship
Plant the seed in the damp soil
Ask where to plant the seed
Follow the sound
Follow the sign to the water
Rest in the ship
Plant the seed in the flower bed
Back to the ship, note the location
Follow the rumble down the slope
Back to the lodging

objectives.zh: 把种子种进广场外的花圃
objectives.en: Plant the seed in the bed outside the plaza
Go back to the bench
Walk around the plaza on your own
Go round the fountain on your own
Go out
Back to the lodging
Go to the plaza

lines.en: Niff's still waiting for me to finish.
The sign points to the water.
Haven't checked the far end of the plaza.

start_final.zh: 弥洛看见，又要说我放错边了。
start_final.en: If Milo saw this, she'd say I put it on the wrong side again.
...Just the broken bits. Saving the rest.

start_final.zh: 差不多就这样，你又不会告状。
start_final.en: Close enough. Not like you'll tell on me.

final_niff_msg.zh:
晨，你吃饭了吗？我刚翻到本子，上面还写着你肚子饿呢。
啊，后面写了，吃过面包啦，那现在呢？
final_niff_msg.en:
Chen, have you eaten? I just found my notebook, and it says you're hungry.
Ah, the next line says you had bread. So what about now?

reply.en: A few biscuits left. Eating them now.

final_niff_msg.zh: 阿汀让我提醒你，到地方记得晾浮筒哦，里面很容易存水。
final_niff_msg.en: Ting says to remind you: dry out the floats when you land. Water gets in easily.

reply.en: Got it. I'll dry them when I land.

final_niff_msg.zh: 维修：到地方先晾浮筒（阿汀说的）。
final_niff_msg.en: Repairs: dry the floats first thing after landing (Ting said).

final_route.zh: 前面的航道……比记录上乱。
final_route.en: The route ahead... it's messier than the records said.

final_route.spec: 接近云层星的航道比旧记录复杂。碎石带向外扩展，稳定气流只剩几条窄路，玩家需要综合运用声音辨向、避障和修补。正确操作能减少燃料损耗，此前多收集的材料也在这里发挥作用。操作与准备能省下一部分材料，剩余航程仍需要玩家从纪念品中作出取舍。

cab_count.zh: 燃料柜：河水、种子、音乐盒、铜铃……
cab_count.en: Fuel locker: river water, seed, music box, copper bell...

cab_think.zh: 都到这里了。现在不去，前面那些不就……
cab_think.en: I've come this far. If I don't go now, then everything before was just...

cab_think.zh: 再往前飞，烧掉的东西也回不来了。
cab_think.en: Flying on won't bring back what I burned, either.

cab_think.zh: 大象我还是想找，消息也还是想等。
cab_think.en: I still want to find the elephant. And I still want to wait for that message.

final_fuel.spec: 【最终航行：将听声避障、简短修补和燃料选择结合。选择物品时飞机进入稳定航行状态，玩家可以阅读说明、最后播放声音或取消选择。确认转化后消耗所选物品，其余纪念品保留。列表仅显示当前持有的物品。】（剧本约定：可以做成 flight1 的 keepsake_choice 加多选 / 可退出；选中一件时播 look_<物品id>，确认转化后播 burn_<物品id>；蓝色石头 / 通勤卡剩下的那件用 burn_final_<id>。）

options.en: Just get through the next stretch.
I still want to keep these.

narr.zh: 燃料不足。纸质物品可用。

final_paper.spec: 【日记首页为始终保留的剧情物件，不计入可转化燃料。日记首页在所有物品选择及四个结局中均予保留，“我一定要找到大象，因为”后面始终空着，页面仅供查看。】

look_river_water.en: Last of all, whether I've eaten.
...Three minutes. Just enough for her to go through it once more.

look_clear_seed.zh: 不要埋太深。先浇水。别总挖出来看。
look_clear_seed.en: Don't bury it too deep. Water it first. Don't keep digging it up to check.

narr.zh: 没长出来不一定是你的问题。
narr.en: If nothing comes up, it might not be your fault.

look_clear_seed.en: Inside... there's a very thin line.

narr.en: South Bridge, day seven after the flood

look_elephant_footage.en: ...But I can't copy down this sound.

narr.en: Given to Chen. No need to return

look_journal.en: Drew the deer's antlers too big.

narr.zh: 送给你啦，以后就是你的了。

look_journal.zh: 这串数字，是干什么用的？

look_journal.en: The elephant notes keep getting longer.

look_journal.zh: 后来是声音、脚印、照片、船号……
look_journal.en: Then a sound, footprints, a photo, a ship number...
And the notch in the ear.

narr.zh: 我一定要找到大象，因为
narr.en: I have to find the elephant, because

look_home_photo.en: The arrows and notes are still there.

look_species_query.en: ...It was always tucked under the drawing.

burn_species_query.en: Don't need to carry this one anymore.

look_postcard.en: Milo pushed it over to me.

look_seat_chart.en: The seats that get the sun.

look_seat_chart.zh: 第三节车厢的门，关得很响。

narr.zh: 下次一起去看看云层里的大象
narr.en: Next time, let's go see the elephant in the clouds together

final_approach.zh: 我以前老觉得，找到大象，再收到她的消息，
final_approach.en: I always thought that if I found the elephant, and then heard from her,
everything else would sort itself out.

narr.zh: 我一定要找到大象，因为
narr.en: I have to find the elephant, because

approach_page.zh: 可大象就算在那儿，她也不一定回我啊。
approach_page.en: But even if the elephant's there, she might not write back.

approach_page.zh: 这些我也舍不得，得再想想。
approach_page.en: I can't let go of these either. I need to think.

final_action.spec: 【行动选择：继续投入物品，进入下降航道；或关闭主推进器，进入安全漂行轨道。此处为实际行动选择，不同于此前会汇合的普通对话选项。进入安全漂行轨道触发结局四。确认下降后，进入下方的最终导航选择。】

label.zh: 继续投入物品，进入下降航道
label.en: Burn more, enter the descent lane

label.zh: 关闭主推进器，进入安全漂行轨道
label.en: Cut the main thruster, enter a safe drift orbit

narr.zh: 西侧：旧货场。运输船号对上了。
narr.en: West: old freight yard. Transport ship number matches.

narr.zh: 东侧：低鸣。声源无法确定。

final_descend.zh: 广场附近有大型动物停留。
final_descend.en: A large animal is lingering near the plaza.

final_descend.zh: 广场附近有大型动物停留。
final_descend.en: A large animal is lingering near the plaza.
Okay. This time I look properly before I go down.

final_descend.spec: 【最终导航选择：前往西侧旧货场，触发结局一；朝东侧低鸣的位置降落，触发结局二；接受城市引导，前往居民区，触发结局三。选择后显示确认提示。普通对话选项不参与结局判定，保留的物品只影响结局中的具体动作与人物尾声。】

label.en: Head west to the old freight yard

label.zh: 朝东侧低鸣的位置降落
label.en: Land toward the low rumble in the east

label.zh: 接受城市引导，前往居民区
label.en: Follow city guidance to the residential area

ck_bell.en: Don't knock against the window frame.

ck_copilot.zh: 一直空着，我也一直在跟它说话。
ck_copilot.en: Always empty. I keep talking to it anyway.

ck_cabinet.zh: 每一格，我都知道放的是什么。
ck_cabinet.en: I know what's in every slot.

ck_tools.en: The one I use most, on the left.

ck_drawing.zh: 耳朵画小了。缺口是后来补的。
ck_drawing.en: Drew the ears too small. Added the notch later.

ending1.zh: 温度还行。冒烟的……在这边。
ending1.en: Temperature's okay. The smoke's... coming from here.

ending1.zh: 工具……放这儿，伸手就拿得到。

yard_sign.en: The sign from the transport records.
The arrow points to the water.

e1_prints.en: In the shallows... such wide footprints.

e1_meet.en: I've been looking for you for a long time.
Don't keep your bag so close.

e1_meet.zh: 它有时候会伸鼻子拿东西。
e1_meet.en: Sometimes it helps itself with its nose.

e1_meet.zh: 尤其爱翻有吃的味道的袋子。
e1_meet.en: Especially bags that smell like food.
Not this. It's the last of it.

options.en: So you're this loud when you eat.
Can I watch you a little longer?

options.zh: 我还以为，见到你以后会有很多话。
options.en: I thought I'd have so much to say when I met you.

e1_ch_a.en: You can hear it from halfway across the river.

e1_ch_c.en: ...And now I can't think of a single thing.

e1_sit.en: I've been looking for it for...

e1_sit.zh: 我以前以为，找到它以后，我一定会高兴得不得了。
e1_sit.en: I used to think that when I found it, I'd be over the moon.

e1_sit.zh: 刚才确实挺高兴。现在腿有点麻，还有点饿。
e1_sit.en: And I was, just now. Now my legs are asleep, and I'm a bit hungry.

e1_sit.zh: 吃的话，往那边走，有个小摊。
e1_sit.en: If you want food, there's a stall that way.
I'm going to get something to eat.

e1_seed_hint.en: The seed... I should ask where to plant it.

e1_note.en: When I get back, I'll tell her the truth.

e1_plant_ask.en: Is there anywhere around here to plant something?
The damp soil by the water's fine.

e1_plant_ask.zh: 别太靠近它吃草的地方。
e1_plant_ask.en: Just not too close to where it grazes.

e1_plant.en: Don't keep digging it up to check.

e1_elephant_chat.en: ...Done with this patch, on to the next.

e1_passerby_chat.en: It's not afraid of people. Doesn't care about them either.
Just don't fight it for anything.

e1_paper_get.zh: 日记烧了。跟居民借的纸，记这儿。
e1_paper_get.en: Burned the journal. Borrowed paper from a local. Writing here.

e1_write.zh: 今天找到大象了。左耳有缺口，吃草很响，会翻袋子。
e1_write.en: Found the elephant today. Notch in the left ear. Loud when it eats grass. Goes through bags.

narr.zh: 我一定要找到大象，因为
narr.en: I have to find the elephant, because

e2_see.en: You've been standing here a while.

e2_footage.en: But not here in front of us.

e2_explain.en: A piece of its ear is missing.
Its nose just touched the ground.
When it moves, the grass on the left sways.
A piece of its ear is missing! Look!

e2_explain.zh: 可我眼前就是一块草地啊。
e2_explain.en: but all I see is a patch of grass.
Sit down for a bit. Have some water.
I can see it right now.

options.zh: 你可以再陪我站一会儿吗？
options.en: Could you stand here with me a little longer?
I want to write down where it is first.
Just leave the water there. Thanks.

e2_ch_a.en: Not like I've got anything else to do.

e2_dusk.en: Need a hand with the ship?
Someone needs to hold up the left strut.
Then I'll come back when it's light.

e2_elephant_chat.en: ...Only I can see it. It's still here.

e2_paper_get.zh: 日记烧了。先写在借来的纸上。
e2_paper_get.en: Burned the journal. Borrowed paper for now.

e2_write.zh: 位置：居民区外，缓坡下的树旁。往水边走。
e2_write.en: Location: outside the residential area, by the tree at the foot of the slope. Heads for the water.
Sound: once at dusk, lower than the wind.

e2_seed_hint.zh: 种子……附近有个围起来的花圃。
e2_seed_hint.en: The seed... there's a fenced flower bed nearby.

e2_plant.en: It's fenced in. No one will step on it.

e2_night.en: Hold it up for me once more.

e2_night.zh: 早上，大象从机翼后面过去。
e2_night.en: Morning: the elephant walked past behind the wing.

e2_night.zh: 来帮忙的：昨天坐在旁边的那位居民。
e2_night.en: Helping: the resident who sat with me yesterday.
The wing still needs one more bracket.

ending3.zh: 绳子给我，飞机我们帮你固定。
ending3.en: Give me the rope. We'll tie down your ship.

ending3.zh: 它今天一直在喷泉那边。
ending3.en: It's been by the fountain all day.

town_basket.en: It knocked that over just now.
Don't get between it and the water.

e3_plaza.en: Look at its ear. There's a piece missing.

e3_plaza.zh: 站我这儿。顺着我的手看。
它刚挪了。你一直看错地方了。
e3_plaza.en: It just moved. You've been looking in the wrong place.

e3_ask.zh: 大家看到的，是这一头吗？
e3_ask.en: Is this the one you're all seeing?

e3_ask.zh: 刚才它还把鼻子伸进喷泉里！
e3_ask.en: It just stuck its nose in the fountain!

e3_ask.zh: 今天先回去歇着吧。明天再来。
e3_ask.en: Go get some rest today. Come back tomorrow.

e3_touch.en: It's right in front of you now.

e3_paper_get.zh: 日记烧了。跟他们借了几张纸。
e3_paper_get.en: Burned the journal. Borrowed a few sheets from them.

e3_write1.zh: 今天，我终于见到了大象
e3_write1.en: Today I finally met the elephant
At least, that's what they all say
It really took to you today!

e3_confess.zh: 昨天我伸手的时候，手心里是空的。
e3_confess.en: Yesterday, when I reached out, my hand touched nothing.
...Huh? Well, let me tell you, it was right...
I know where I was standing yesterday.

e3_listen.en: They say it's swinging its nose

e3_listen.zh: 你说的我记着了，我自己看见的也得照实写。
e3_listen.en: I wrote down what you told me. But I have to write what I saw, too.

e3_listen.zh: 昨天，我们以为你真摸到了。
e3_listen.en: Yesterday, we thought you'd really touched it.
That's why everyone was so happy.

e3_listen.zh: 我知道。我也想让你们高兴。
e3_listen.en: I know. I wanted you to be happy, too.

e3_listen.zh: 而且，都走了这么远，我不太敢说还是没找到。
e3_listen.en: And after coming all this way, I couldn't bring myself to say I still hadn't found it.

options.en: I want to look on my own for a while.
I need to fix what I wrote yesterday.

options.zh: 你可以陪着，但先别告诉我该看见什么。
options.en: You can stay, but don't tell me what I should see.

e3_ch_b.en: We got ahead of ourselves yesterday.

e3_wait.en: I'll sit here and wait for you.

e3_bench.zh: 我今天看见的还是那块空地。
e3_bench.en: All I saw today was the same empty ground.

e3_seed_ask.en: Anywhere around here I can plant something?
There's a little flower bed just outside the plaza.

e3_seed_ask.zh: 上午晒得到太阳，水从那边的龙头取。
e3_seed_ask.en: It gets sun in the morning. There's a tap over there for water.

e3_seedless.en: Could I borrow a few more sheets of paper?
There's news I need to take back.

e3_plant.en: Don't bury it too deep. Water it first.

e3_night.match: 今天，我终于见到了大象

e3_night.zh: 昨天我看见一块空地，伸出去的手也落了空。那时候不好意思说。
e3_night.en: Yesterday I saw empty ground, and my hand reached into nothing. I was too embarrassed to say so then.

e3_night.zh: 今天：喷泉这边、另一侧、长椅旁边，都看过。
e3_night.en: Today: this side of the fountain, the other side, by the bench. Looked at all of it.

e3_night.zh: （画了喷泉的形状）下次换一条路线。
e3_night.en: (a sketch of the fountain) Try a different route next time.
Can I get savory bread there?
I'll save you a crusty end.

e3_fountain_look.en: The paving stones are all wet.

narr.zh: 进入轨道后，可以关闭主推进器。
narr.en: Once in orbit, the main thruster can be shut off.

narr.zh: 着陆需要重新选择下降航线。
narr.en: Landing will require choosing a new descent route.

ending4.zh: 我还是想下去，也还是想收到她的消息。
ending4.en: I still want to go down. I still want to hear from her.

e4_bell_move.en: Move it over a bit. No more knocking the window frame.

e4_page_loose.en: ...I'll write on the back of the chart.

narr.zh: 我一定要找到大象，因为
narr.en: I have to find the elephant, because

e4_write.zh: 坐标：云层之上，安全漂行轨道。
e4_write.en: Position: above the clouds, safe drift orbit.

e4_write.zh: 要修：右侧接口，慢慢漏气。
e4_write.en: To fix: right-side joint, slow leak.

e4_write.zh: （空着。圈了几处最近能补给的地方。）
e4_write.en: (Blank. A few nearby supply stops circled.)

epilogue.spec: 【以下为四个结局后的条件尾声，呈现晨后来回访时的片段，不表示飞机在结局后立即修好。大象的结局改变晨带回的描述，物品状态改变相关动作和局部对白。】

epilogue.en: Was the road out there rough?
First the debris belt. I had to go around.

epilogue.zh: 旧地图上的跑道，泡在水里了。
epilogue.en: The runway on the old map is underwater now.

epilogue.zh: 那这块得改。后面要是还有人来，咱可不能再照着带。
epilogue.en: Then this part needs fixing. If anyone else comes, I can't lead them by this anymore.
Places I haven't been, I'll leave blank.

epi_deer_e1.en: Eating grass by the water. Very loudly.

epi_deer_e1.zh: 左耳缺了一块。不怎么理人。
epi_deer_e1.en: A piece missing from its left ear. Doesn't pay people much mind.

epi_deer_e2.en: I saw it. I can see it.

epi_deer_e3.en: They all said it was there.
All I ever saw was empty ground.
...Then just say you didn't see it.
That's what I didn't say, before.

epi_deer_e4.en: That time, I stopped above the clouds.
Then I came back. For now.
Stopping's fine. The road's not going anywhere.

epi_deer_sign.zh: 空地上那个路标，你还过去的。
epi_deer_sign.en: That signpost in the clearing, the one you brought back.

epi_deer_sign.zh: 到现在不转了，一直指着云那边。
epi_deer_sign.en: It doesn't spin anymore. It just points at the clouds.

epi_deer_rock2.zh: 空地石头上那头，画得也不准。
epi_deer_rock2.en: The one on the rock in the clearing isn't drawn right either.

epi_deer_chat.zh: 下回来，先在路口喊一声。
epi_deer_chat.en: Next time, give a shout at the turnoff.

epi_miluo.zh: 河流城市来客册里抄的。
epi_miluo.en: Copied from the guestbook in the river city.

epi_miluo.zh: 船名，日期。还有杯底的记号。
epi_miluo.en: Ship name, date. And the mark from the bottom of the cup.
That person did write to you.

epi_miluo.zh: 北岸的邮箱，后来被水冲走了。
epi_miluo.en: The mailbox on the north bank got washed away.

epi_miluo.zh: 挑个不会掉进河里的邮箱，很难吗？
epi_miluo.en: Was it that hard to pick a mailbox that wouldn't fall in the river?

epi_miluo_planted.en: Watered it. Didn't dig it up to check.
Fine. That's all I wanted to ask.

epi_miluo_kept.zh: 那就继续好好放着。别一脸现在就要交作业的样子。
epi_miluo_kept.en: Then keep it safe. And stop looking like you're handing in homework.

epi_miluo_burned.zh: 去云层星的路上，燃料不够。
epi_miluo_burned.en: On the way to the Cloud Planet. There wasn't enough fuel.

epi_miluo_burned.zh: 我算了好几遍，最后还是放进去了。
epi_miluo_burned.en: I counted again and again. In the end I put it in.

epi_miluo_burned.zh: 你倒是终于知道，难听的话也得当面说了。
epi_miluo_burned.en: So you've finally learned to say the hard stuff to someone's face.

epi_miluo_burned.zh: 递过来啊，站那儿干吗，光都给你挡住了。
epi_miluo_burned.en: Hand it over, then. Don't just stand there, you're in my light.

epi_miluo_returned.zh: 那只鹿说，小吃棚的收音机，前几天自己响了。
epi_miluo_returned.en: The deer says the radio at the snack stall came on by itself a few days ago.

epi_miluo_chat.en: Don't just stand in the doorway.

epi_miluo_chat.zh: 要走就走，要坐就坐。别坐那把。
epi_miluo_chat.en: Go or sit, one or the other. Not that chair.

epi_niff.en: ...Chen! Chen, who's going to the Cloud Planet to find the elephant!
Go on, go on. I'm listening.

epi_niff_e1.en: It's loud when it eats grass.
It flaps its ears. Doesn't pay people much mind.

epi_niff_e2.zh: 找到了。可只有我看得见。
epi_niff_e2.en: I found it. But only I can see it.

epi_niff_e2.zh: 别人没看见，也是发生过的事呀。
epi_niff_e2.en: Even if nobody else saw it, it still happened.

epi_niff_e3.zh: 我眼前，一直是一块空地。
epi_niff_e3.en: All I ever saw was a patch of empty ground.
They all said it was there.
Hmm... then draw the empty ground.

epi_niff_e4.en: Wow. A ship asleep on the clouds.

epi_niff_nofootage.en: The parts I can't remember, I left blank.

epi_niff_bell.en: This part's empty. Did you forget?

epi_niff_bell.zh: 那先放着嘛。你哪天知道了，再告诉我呀。
epi_niff_bell.en: Then leave it for now. Tell me when you know.

epi_niff_bell.zh: 啊，拿错啦。这个才是你的。
epi_niff_bell.en: Ah, wrong one. This one's yours.

epi_niff_chat.en: This page says: Chen came back.

epi_niff_chat.zh: 嘿嘿，这次没写成湿湿的人。
epi_niff_chat.en: Hehe. Didn't write "the soggy one" this time.

narr.zh: 我一定要找到大象，因为
narr.en: I have to find the elephant, because
